messages:
sara-support: Customer (Acme Retail) reports ~12k objects not removed after Delete API returns 202. They say default retention was 90d but they set custom 365d for a bucket last month. Deletes look accepted but objects still visible via list API and in UI. Can we triage?

arjun-sre: Can you paste the original delete request headers/response (request-id) and one example object id? Also did they use dedicated/private?

sara-support: Using hosted API. Example object id: obj_8f3a2c1b. Request-id: r-20260314120733-6f3b. Response body was 202 {"job_id":"deljob-44b", "status":"queued"}. No immediate error.

kayla-security: Noted they had a KMS key rollover on 2026-03-12 for the customer CMK (key-id: key-acme-02). Need KMS audit logs for rewrap events and HSM key version mapping. If objects are still encrypted with old key version, the delete worker might be failing to rewrap/verify and silently skipping.

arjun-sre: Quick checks I'll ask you to run and share results: 1) redis queue length: `redis-cli -h redis.prod.int LLEN deletion_queue` 2) worker health: `systemctl status deletion-worker.service` or `ps aux | grep deletion-worker` 3) lookup job status: `SELECT status FROM deletion_jobs WHERE job_id='deljob-44b';` (postgres readonly).

sara-support: Ran redis check: returned 1240. systemctl shows 2 workers active. SQL returned job status = 'processing' for deljob-44b.

arjun-sre: High backlog. Possibly a processing error on items that require KMS operations. Can you get the application logs around the job processing? Grep for the object id or job id:

```
Mar 14 12:07:34 deletion-worker[99]: INFO process_job deljob-44b object=obj_8f3a2c1b
Mar 14 12:07:34 deletion-worker[99]: ERROR rewrap_failed key=key-acme-02 err=HSM_UNAVAILABLE
Mar 14 12:07:34 deletion-worker[99]: WARN mark_pending_retry obj=obj_8f3a2c1b retry_after=30s
```

kayla-security: HSM_UNAVAILABLE wrapped errors during rotation window — we need HSM access logs and KMS admin audit to confirm whether rewraps failed en masse. Also confirm we didn't create a new key alias that points to different material.

mike-engr: If rewraps are failing the deletion worker should surface errors in Sentry. @arjun-sre can you check Sentry for r-20260314120733-6f3b and search for HSM_UNAVAILABLE errors aggregated around 2026-03-12..14? If we confirm, mitigation is to retry rewraps after HSM restores or perform a backend migration: re-encrypt objects to new key version (requires legal sign-off).

arjun-sre: Sentry shows ~4k occurrences of HSM_UNAVAILABLE between 03/12 00:00 and 03/13 06:00, matching the key rollover window. Next steps I recommend: 1) Escalate to KMS/HSM team with key-id and timestamps. 2) Run a targeted reprocess for Acme objects (safe retry path) with rate limit. 3) Provide customer timeline: estimated deletion completion ETA = backlog / throughput. Current throughput with 2 workers ~1200 deletes/hr => ~10 hours to clear 12k if HSM is healthy.

sara-support: Noted. I'll open an official escalation to KMS with key-acme-02 and attach logs. Also informing CS to set customer expectations (~12-14 hours ETA assuming no additional errors). @caroline-cs heads-up to message customer. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260314-07 - KMS rollover caused deletion worker failures (linked to thread 1769000001)

caroline-cs: I'll send an interim note: "We're investigating a KMS-related issue that caused a deletion backlog. We've kicked off retries and are escalating to our security team. Estimated completion ~12-14 hours; we'll update at 3h intervals."

arjun-sre: Also adding a short-term mitigation: pause any additional retention changes for the customer's org until rewraps complete, and don't perform key rotations for that CMK until HSM team confirms stability.

sara-support: Thanks — escalation created, attaching logs and Sentry links in the ticket. Will post updates here when KMS team responds. :white_check_mark:
